name: notify
description: Human-facing notifications: desktop notify-send plus a durable file outbox at $AGENT_TOOLS_HOME/outbox/. 'finish' is the terminal signal for agent loops.
use_when: alerting the human a task needs attention or is complete

args.name: send
args.description: --title T [--body B]. Desktop popup + outbox record.

env.AGENT_TOOLS_HOME: State root; notifications also land in <root>/outbox/.

notes: Works headless: notification is recorded to outbox even when notify-send is absent.
